linear-control-systems--steady-state-err.title: Steady-state error by system type
linear-control-systems--steady-state-err.note: Type is the number of open-loop integrators; each extra one lets the loop follow a higher-order input with finite error.

linear-control-systems--pid-controller.title: Effect of raising each PID term
linear-control-systems--pid-controller.note: Classical monotonic trends for a fixed plant: the integral term removes offset, the derivative term damps the approach.

linear-control-systems--overshoot.title: Peak overshoot from the peak time
linear-control-systems--overshoot.note: At the first peak the sine argument is pi plus arccos zeta, and the root factors cancel so only the exponential decay survives.

linear-control-systems--root-locus.title: Root-locus construction rules

linear-control-systems--root-locus.note: The first four rules fix the skeleton; the rest place the points where branches split, cross the imaginary axis, or leave a complex pole.

linear-control-systems--routh-hurwitz-cr.title: Routh array special cases

linear-control-systems--routh-hurwitz-cr.note: Both special cases hide roots on or symmetric about the imaginary axis; the epsilon and derivative tricks expose them without changing the count.

linear-control-systems--state-transition.title: Matrix exponential to resolvent
linear-control-systems--state-transition.note: Term-by-term transformation turns the series into a geometric series in A/s, whose sum is the resolvent matrix.

linear-control-systems--bode-plot.title: Bode asymptotes by factor
linear-control-systems--bode-plot.note: Each factor adds one straight-line pair, so the full plot is the sum of these pieces added on the logarithmic frequency axis.
